messages:
Rae (Marketing): Heads up: we need a concise bench run for the launch blog + webinar. Goal: p50/p95/p99 latencies, estimated cost per 1k tokens, and an embeddings throughput number for one callout. Need a 1-slide PNG and raw CSVs. Deadline: Wednesday EOD.

Rae (Marketing): Models of interest: redwood-v3-small, redwood-v3-large, plus a quantized large candidate. Run both hosted API and Dedicated (H100 preferred).

Diego (Eng Runtime): Quick checks: live-demo numbers = short chat (~30-50 tokens)? Long sample for deep dive? Also want warm vs cold cache?

Rae (Marketing): Yes short demo ~45 tokens. For deep-dive include one 2500-token sample. Warm cache numbers are primary. Cold cache ok as a footnote.

Ava (DevEx): Use bench-runner template (go/redwood/bench-runbook). Tag runs with marketing-launch-2026-v2. Include docker image + git sha in job notes. We also capture GPU util and token emission timing.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Plan: hosted smoke (100 short prompts, conc 1 & 16), dedicated H100 run (short + long), quantized short run. Embeddings: 2k vectors, batch sizes 1/128/512. Output: per-request CSV + aggregated p50/p95/p99 and a slide.

ops-bot: Job scheduled: bench-runner/marketing-launch-2026-v2 on runner-h100-2. Job id: br-77702. ETA ~90m.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Will seed long samples for repeatability. Note: 8bit quant can change throughput by ~10-20% depending on kernel; will capture quality notes if we do simple BLEU-like check.

Rae (Marketing): For cost, publish retail-per-1k-token figure. Add an internal cost line in the notes for sales. Keep public wording simple.

Ava (DevEx): Please attach the bench command and the exact run metadata to the job. If any p99 > 1s, include system trace.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Starting hosted smoke now, will post CSV link when done, then run H100 suite.

Rae (Marketing): Thanks — ping when slide PNG is ready so design can add it to the press kit. :rocket:
